settings.name: pollen
settings.label: Pollen
settings.says: How many pollen start in the spindexer, one each side of the arms against the wall.

settings.name: first_pollen
settings.label: First pollen
settings.says: Where the first pollen starts against the wall, in degrees clockwise seen from above, from the back.

settings.name: second_pollen
settings.label: Second pollen
settings.says: Where the second pollen starts against the wall, in degrees clockwise seen from above, from the back.

settings.name: spinner_power
settings.label: Spinner power
settings.says: The power the spinner's continuous servo is set to: 1 turns it clockwise seen from above at full speed, -1 the other way and 0 stops it.

settings.name: spinner_speed
settings.label: Spinner speed
settings.says: How fast the spinner turns at full power with nothing holding it back.

settings.name: spinner_stall
settings.label: Spinner stall torque
settings.says: The load that stops the spinner; it slows in proportion as its load nears this.

settings.name: ramp_down
settings.label: Ramp down
settings.says: The ramp bar's angle when it is down: 0 is as drawn, below the floor.

settings.name: ramp_up
settings.label: Ramp up
settings.says: The ramp bar's angle when it is up, lifting a pollen at the back toward the wheel.

settings.name: ramp_raised_at
settings.label: Raised at
settings.says: When the ramp's servo is commanded up.

settings.name: ramp_lowered_at
settings.label: Lowered at
settings.says: When the ramp's servo is commanded back down.

settings.name: ramp_servo_speed
settings.label: Ramp servo speed
settings.says: How long the ramp's servo takes to turn 60 degrees.

settings.name: back_sill
settings.label: Back sill
settings.says: How high the back window's sill is above the floor slab's underside. The floor's top is at 15, and the CAD draws the sill at 43.12, where it holds a lifted pollen against the wheel.

settings.name: flywheel
settings.label: Flywheel speed
settings.says: How fast the flywheel's motor is commanded to turn, as the robot's code commands it.

settings.name: run
settings.label: Run length
settings.says: The longest a feed is followed; it ends sooner once every pollen has left or come to rest.

ending.says: every pollen has left the spindexer
every pollen has left the spindexer

refused.rule: Back sill is from 16.0 to 95.0 mm, not 10.0
